title: Error response envelope (shape only)
x-verification: Shape only: same envelope as success, per the OAS ('code', 'message' describing the failure reason, 'request_id'). Error code VALUES are not documented in any readable official source and are deliberately not enumerated. Codes seen only in the official FAQ index: 105004, 36004001 ('rt has expired', legacy refresh path), 36009003 - meanings not documented.
